title: Stepwise MXene and MOF conversion assisted ultrathin dual-carbon-protected V2O3 nanosheets for ultrafast and durable Zn-ion storage
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,897-909
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04387A, Paper
Xiaolin Ma, Ke Han, Hongxing Li, Lulu Song, Yuan Lin, Liangxu Lin, Yang Liu, Yi Zhao, Zhen Yang, Wei Huang
Ultrathin dual-carbon-protected V2O3 nanosheets are developed through stepwise MXene and MOF conversion to realize ultrafast and durable zinc-ion storage.
